limitations.text: No warehouse inventory produced. The task has no usable imagery source (imagery_window returned not_allowed), there are no labelled training examples for this AOI (get_examples returned none), and zero_shot_text is not configured. The only embedding index built (aef-10m-annual, 160 m cells, 3920 cells) is a synthetic fixture, and with no positives I couldn't train or query it for warehouses. Without visual confirmation I couldn't separate warehouses from factories, markets or other large roofs. Count: 0 confirmed, with an unknown range (cannot be bounded). The whole AOI (~10x9 km) is unreviewed. Not a claim of absence.

understanding.goal_restated: Find warehouses (>=~1600 m2 logistics/storage buildings) in AOI near Chattogram, Bangladesh (91.78-91.88E, 22.28-22.36N), reporting points with evidence, a count range, and explicit gaps.
known_limits: 10 m GSD makes distinguishing warehouses from factories/markets hard
understanding.scope: AOI ~10x9 km, 2024 data. Sentinel-2 10 m imagery and embeddings only; warehouses are near the 10 m resolution limit.
